description: Render a Brilliant UI component into an EXACT declarative state and capture it to an image file, offscreen, without touching the live app. `component` is a stager id (call list_stagers to enumerate them and their state schemas); `state` is the component-specific declarative state. Optionally draw highlight boxes over sub-targets (the scene registers "ui-stage.*" ids) and override the stage size. Writes lossless WebP by default. Desktop-only: it writes an image file, so it is not available in the web editor.

anyOf.description: Optional. true answers a `job:` id at once and runs the call on; wait({job}) blocks until it ends and answers its result. An edit waits its turn behind other agents' writes instead of refusing. Use it for a call that may outlast your client's timeout.

background.description: Optional. true answers a `job:` id at once and runs the call on; wait({job}) blocks until it ends and answers its result. An edit waits its turn behind other agents' writes instead of refusing. Use it for a call that may outlast your client's timeout.

component.description: Stager id to render (e.g. "ai-chat-panel"). REQUIRED. Call list_stagers for the available ids and their schemas.

anyOf.description: Logical stage height override (defaults to the stager's defaultSize).

height.description: Logical stage height override (defaults to the stager's defaultSize).

anyOf.description: Boxes to draw over the render. Each is either {target: "<ui-stage.* id>"} or {rect: [x, y, w, h]} in captured-image logical pixels.
[x, y, w, h] in captured-image logical pixels.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in captured-image logical pixels.

highlights.description: Boxes to draw over the render. Each is either {target: "<ui-stage.* id>"} or {rect: [x, y, w, h]} in captured-image logical pixels.

outputPath.description: Absolute file path to write the image to. REQUIRED.

anyOf.description: Component-specific declarative state. REQUIRED. See the component's stateSchema from list_stagers.

state.description: Component-specific declarative state. REQUIRED. See the component's stateSchema from list_stagers.

anyOf.description: Logical stage width override (defaults to the stager's defaultSize).

width.description: Logical stage width override (defaults to the stager's defaultSize).

name: render_ui
